compatibility_changes: HyperFrames main after v0.8.33 adds runtime media-start resolution shared across playback, timeline visibility, manifest, audio scheduling, and volume probing. reCast now exposes an independent pure resolveMediaStart contract so nested media can use one coordinate rule across render-related paths.

HyperFrames main adds render/browser hardening: retry browser initialization once, validate malformed JPEG inputs before encoding, and validate captured image/font/Lottie downloads. reCast independently retries Chromium initialization once in the deterministic CLI renderer and continues to validate render dimensions, frame counts, and output artifacts.

HyperFrames main tightens security around runtime, Studio preview, slideshow, and registry message dispatch by authenticating message senders. reCast now accepts seek control messages only from its mounted preview frame rather than any window.

HyperFrames main adds integrity verification for CDN scripts before inlining and stronger project/asset path containment. reCast does not currently inline remote scripts or expose the corresponding Studio project filesystem, so no unsupported API was added.

HyperFrames main improves registry CLI bounds and hosted-asset handling and expands catalog carousels. reCast has no registry/catalog installer surface, so those behaviors remain documented rather than copied.
HyperFrames main also improves build atomicity and test robustness. reCast's repository validation remains independently implemented and should not depend on upstream test internals.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
